protocol.matrix_contract: Copy each original submitted_problem.npz with identical original bytes/SHA. Reuse the actual stored CSR, RHS, bounds, objective, constants, reference solution and seven endpoint indices. No coefficient, domain, target or tolerance change.
protocol.ordering: Four original status-2 cases, each dual simplex then interior point, all once even on any failure. Both methods are reported; the first is the predeclared primary diagnostic, the second a separate cross-check, never a fallback.
protocol.interpretation: Two p100 reference solutions already satisfy all original and added constraints within the frozen tolerance despite status 2. Solver statuses alone do not certify physical infeasibility. New successful solutions must pass unchanged primal/dual, physical replay, prefix, ENS/CO2/peak and full endpoint gates.

metrics.information_contract: Exact saved endpoint-matched matrix; fixed 48h prefix; true 312h
metrics.stock_holding_assumption: 5 percent/year on committed initial fuel inventory value, prorated by modeled hours; engineering capital charge, not observed storage tariff. Reported separately and not a dispatch decision cost.
metrics.valuation_scope: Declared constant engineering unit values. Fuel arrivals plus initial-minus-terminal stock equal consumption; coal/gas unit values reproduce generation fuel costs. Nonfossil operating costs are separate. SOC draw is charged at a common 0.32 million CNY/GWh. Not observed market prices or national welfare.
metrics.boundary: Single aggregate bus, continuous ramp-constrained plants; no unit commitment, spatial network or empirical hourly calibration. Hydro is an exogenous available-flow bound. Arrivals are domestic/import flows, not unconstrained balancing fuel. Daily flexible-load deadlines and final zero debt; battery and pumped SOC at the actual global endpoint must equal full energy capacity; fuel terminal inventory remains free and valued at the original prices.

original_physical_audit.interpretation: Actions and end states are independently reconstructed; state-accounting verification is not empirical hourly validation.
